data.one_liner: Utility widgets that connect Flutter applications to a Redux store.
data.what_it_does: Provides StoreProvider, StoreBuilder, and StoreConnector widgets to easily supply a Redux store down the widget tree, build UI from state, and automatically rebuild when state changes.
use_when: You are building an app with complex state logic and want to use Redux for state management.
You want your widgets to automatically rebuild when relevant parts of the Redux store change without manually managing subscriptions.
avoid_when: You are building a simple app where a StatefulWidget is sufficient.
You prefer modern Flutter state management alternatives like Riverpod or Bloc.
strengths: Separates business logic cleanly from UI code.
Automatic subscription handling and widget rebuilding via StoreConnector.
Well-tested and structured around the Redux.dart ecosystem.
weaknesses: Requires boilerplate code typical of Redux patterns.
Older architecture compared to newer state management options.
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml and wrap your application in a StoreProvider.

alternatives.name: flutter_bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a predictable state management solution using the BLoC pattern, which is more commonly used in modern Flutter apps.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a compile-safe, robust, and modern dependency injection and state management solution.
